name: Bell Labs UNIX time-sharing system
description: Bell Labs’ interactive operating system combined a hierarchical file system, processes and command-driven tools, first on a PDP-7 and later PDP-11.

date.basis: Date or approximate interval stated by the source for this event.

events.statement: The early UNIX system ran on PDP-7 and PDP-9 machines around 1969–70.
events.caveats: The retrospective dates a functioning system to an interval, not a precise first execution.

evidence.supports: The revised 1978 paper describes its earliest system as running c. 1969–70.

date.basis: Date or approximate interval stated by the source for this event.

events.statement: PDP-11 UNIX became operational in February 1971.

evidence.supports: Museum attributes central early work to Thompson and Ritchie.
Museum identifies Ritchie as an early contributor.
The authors date PDP-11 operation to February 1971.

date.basis: Date or approximate interval stated by the source for this event.

events.statement: In the 1978 revision of their paper, the authors reported more than 600 UNIX installations had entered service.
events.caveats: A retrospective minimum, not individual users; source publication spans July–August 1978. The authors say many installations did not charge file-space fees; this does not establish free UNIX licensing, public access, or ownership.

evidence.supports: Authors report more than 600 installations in their 1978 revision.
The authors say many installations did not charge for file space.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest dated event established in the cited sources for this scoped record; it does not assert global priority.

measures.subject: PDP-11 UNIX installations in service by 1978 revision
measures.conditions: Authors’ count in the revised 1978 paper; not a count for the original 1974 article or individual users.

evidence.supports: The authors state more than 600 installations in service.

caveats: The 1978 article revises its 1974 paper and includes later features and counts; early UNIX did not appear fully formed and had earlier time-sharing precedents.

research.note: Source-backed initial research; independent review is pending. Independent reader checked the 1978 author account’s installation count and statement that many installations did not charge for file space; these do not establish public access or free software licenses.
